scope_exclusions: One-way root-cycle availability law; no protein exchange between assembly pools and membrane populations, bidirectional biochemical feedback, finite metabolic repair support or autonomous recovery.
Neutral mobile Kv1.5 only on fixed geometry; no charged-cargo field-work feedback, membrane growth, water/flow, cutting, remeshing, active trafficking or wider mobile-channel catalog.
Phenomenological gating bias/closure and synthetic assembly rates; no measured kinetic fit, experimental regeneration, native BETSE redistribution trajectory or BITSEY lineage reproduction.
CPU/L4 independent worlds; planning for at most sixteen GPUs is separate from remote GPU execution or partitioning an interacting tissue across devices.
